answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the atlas log shows the live set and the pigment audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 774 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 172 aliases alive thus means 172 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ridge quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
